PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Suppose Amos were at row 7, column 2: then the victim's clue (alone with the murderer) could not be true. So Amos can't be there. So Amos (A) must be at row 6, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Suppose Cora were at row 5, column 5: then Violet would have nowhere left to go. So Cora can't be there. Using Erin's clue ("She was exactly two rows south of Cora."), some squares are ruled out for Cora. So Cora (C) must be at row 5, column 7. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Amos and Cora crossed out, only one square is left for Faye that fits her clue ("She was in a corner of her area. She was beside a barrel."). So Faye (F) must be at row 1, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Suppose Bruno were at row 3, column 5: then Dexter would have nowhere left to go. So Bruno can't be there. Suppose Bruno were at row 3, column 6: then Violet would have nowhere left to go. So Bruno can't be there. So Bruno (B) must be at row 2, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Dexter that fits his clue ("He was in a corner of his area."). So Dexter (D) must be at row 3, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Violet. So Violet (the victim) must be at row 4, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Erin that fits her clue ("She was exactly two rows south of Cora."). So Erin (E) must be at row 7, column 6. Cross out her row and column. Faye is the only person in the Boathouse with Violet, so Faye is the murderer!
